beats.text: Senegal reached a food production index of 187, while Cuba fell to 48.1.
Senegal leads the world, producing 1.8 times the food output of the USA.
The USA sits near baseline at 104, while Brazil reached 126.
Other top growers are Oman at 180, Tajikistan at 178, and Mozambique at 176.
In contrast, the UK sits at 97.7, and Japan is at 98.2.
